SELECT MIN(o.order_date) AS first_completed_order_date
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.customer_id = 42
  AND o.status = 'completed';
output.explanation: Customer 42's first completed order is the earliest order_date among its orders with status 'completed' in marts.fct_orders. I took "completed" to mean status = 'completed'.
